summary: NatWest Group plc furnished a 6-K reporting daily repurchases under its existing buyback programme, executed via UBS AG, London Branch under instructions issued 16 February 2026. Between 22 and 25 September 2026 the company bought ordinary shares on LSE, CHIX and BATE at volume-weighted prices of roughly 680-696p, with daily highs to 698p and lows to 675.8p. Shares will be cancelled. Post-settlement, NatWest holds 178,249,802 shares in treasury, 7,941,719,832 shares outstanding, and total voting rights of 31,768,811,888. Watch execution pace against the programme's remaining authorisation and any timetable updates.
